full_judgment: 28. Considering section 10(5) of the Abandoned Buildings (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance 1985 it can be said that the presumption of correctness of the entries in the Gazette Notification docs not absolve the Government from denying the fact alleged by the claimant or from disclosing the basis of treating the property as abandoned when it is disputed.
